| slot | why it cannot close |
|:--|:--|
| `lift.embed.local_minimiser_exact` | general claim FALSE (sound_not_exact); only instances hold |

## The four target theorems and what each rests on

| target | theorem | explicit obligations |
|:--|:--|:--|
| T1 compilation preserves meaning | `Compiler.compileProgram_sound` | `Compiler.sound` |
| T2 embedding soundness | `PenaltyEmbedding.embedding_sound_at_minimiser` | `PenaltyExact` |
| T3 extraction equivalence | `semantic_not_injective`, `no_extractor_both_layers` | `Representation.roundtrip` |
| T4 loop convergence | `Repair.progress`, `Repair.preserves` | `absorbs`, `decreases`, `atomic` |
